Date: Saturday, May 17 2025
Time: 2:00 PM
Location: Access Gallery | 222 E Georgia St, Vancouver, BC

Join us at Access Gallery on Saturday, May 17th for a Curator's Tour of Digital
Amalgamations, with guest curator Anna Be.

Digital Amalgamations examines our presence across countless digital cyberspaces
"games, apps, websites"as the boundaries between artificial and physical
realities become troubled. In this emerging transpacial universe, we navigate as
hybrid, plural, and fragmented beings.

An in-depth walkthrough of the exhibition starts at 2:00 pm"free to attend, no
registration required.

Learn more about Digital Amalgamations at the link below:
[https://accessgallery.ca/programming/digital-amalgamations](https://accessgallery.ca/programming/digital-amalgamations)
